goal: Web端中国手语AI教学系统，形成识别—评价—纠错—教学闭环

team.lead: Web + MediaPipe + Siformer/SPOTER + Motion Assessment + FastAPI + integration
team.member1: Dify Agent + knowledge base + MCP/tool layer + teaching feedback
team.member2: data collection/QA + signer split + system testing + competition materials

mvp.input: MediaPipe: 21 left hand + 21 right hand + ~12 upper-body/head landmarks, x/y first
mvp.assessment: Normalization + DTW + landmark geometry; at least 3 stable dimensions
mvp.agent: Dify consumes structured JSON; does not perform visual recognition
mvp.mcp: optional adapter/tool layer; must not block MVP

engineering_rules: do not commit secrets, raw videos, checkpoints, or Dify volumes
Day 6: full end-to-end loop; Day 7+: stability first
